tasks.subject: Task 1: Implement and verify the ProcessDeviceMap fix
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `NtQueryInformationProcess(ProcessDeviceMap)` returns a real `PROCESS_DEVICEMAP_INFORMATION` populated from the emulation root's actual drives, and the SolidWorks installer's `ShellExecuteA` call is re-tested end-to-end to determine whether `sldim.exe` now launches.

**USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** This task was requested by the user in the current conversation. It MUST NOT be closed by walking around it, by declaring it "verified inline", or by substituting a cheaper check. Close only after every item in `acceptanceCriteria` has been re-validated independently, with output captured.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/emulator-platform/platform/process.hpp:1352` (insert new struct right after the existing `PROCESS_PRIORITY_CLASS` struct, before `PROCESS_INSTRUMENTATION_CALLBACK_INFORMATION`)
- Modify: `src/windows-emulator/syscalls/process.cpp:199-203` (replace the `ProcessDeviceMap` case body)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `PROCESS_DEVICEMAP_INFORMATION` is defined with the real Windows layout (`ULONG DriveMap; UCHAR DriveType[32];`)
- [ ] The `ProcessDeviceMap` case populates `DriveMap`'s bit N and `DriveType[N] = DRIVE_FIXED (3)` for every drive letter `file_system::list_drives()` returns, and leaves all other bits/entries at zero
- [ ] `cmake --build --preset=release --target analyzer` succeeds with no new warnings in the touched files
- [ ] A full SolidWorks installer run under `EMULATOR_FEX=1` (three `--click-dialog-button` rules as established this session) either shows a new `NtCreateUserProcess: launching child 3` or `Mapped ...\sldim.exe` line (sldim.exe launches), or completes without it — both are valid, informative results; the outcome determines whether this plan is done or a follow-up task is needed

**Verify:** `grep -n "launching child 3\|Mapped.*sldim\.exe\|Error 5 running command\|Emulation terminated" /tmp/sw_devicemap_fix.log` after a full installer run → presence/absence of the launch lines determines the outcome.

**Steps:** See `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-25-process-devicemap.md` Task 1 for the complete, copy-pasteable code (struct definition, handler replacement) and the exact test invocation command. Summary: (1) add `PROCESS_DEVICEMAP_INFORMATION` struct to `process.hpp`, (2) replace the `ProcessDeviceMap` case in `process.cpp` to populate it from `c.win_emu.file_sys.list_drives()`, (3) build, (4) clang-format + rebuild, (5) run the full installer test under FEX in a background subshell + log file, (6) grep the result and document the outcome, (7) commit.
